architecture_summary: Modular React app. Design system components extracted from Stitch screens. Pages map 1:1 to major screens. Shared UI kit in src/components/. Router use React Router v6. Lazy load pages. CSS modules for scoped styles. No global CSS. Tailwind optional, only if design tokens match exactly. Prefer inline styles for unique one-off designs.

tickets.title: Extract design system components from Stitch screens
tickets.description: Pull button, badge, card, input, loader/skeleton, table, tab, toast/alert from respective Stitch design system screens. Build atomic components in src/components/. Use CSS modules. Export as named exports. No props validation yet. Keep identical to Stitch markup and styles.
acceptance_criteria: Components render pixel-perfect match to Stitch screens
CSS modules used for all styles

tickets.title: Build showcase_playful_bento page
tickets.description: Convert Stitch screen to React page. Use design system components where possible. Inline styles for unique layouts. Page component in src/pages/ShowcasePlayfulBento.jsx. Route path: /showcase.

tickets.title: Build feature_highlights_kids_learning_platform page
tickets.description: Convert Stitch screen to React page. Use design system components. Page component in src/pages/FeatureHighlights.jsx. Route path: /features.

tickets.title: Build 404 error pages (mystery_puzzle, jungle_trail, cosmic_detour)
tickets.description: Convert three Stitch 404 screens to React pages. Use design system components. Pages in src/pages/errors/. Route paths: /404-mystery, /404-jungle, /404-cosmic. Randomly select one on 404 route.

tickets.title: Build design system showcase page
tickets.description: Create single page to showcase all design system components. Use actual components from src/components/. Page in src/pages/DesignSystem.jsx. Route path: /design-system. Include interactive playground for each component.
acceptance_criteria: Page match Stitch design system screens collectively

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create main App shell. Add navigation bar with links to all pages. Set up React Router v6. Lazy load all pages. Add 404 catch-all route. Include Suspense fallback with skeleton loader. App component in src/App.jsx.
acceptance_criteria: Navigation bar present on all pages
Suspense fallback match loader design system
